scientific_integrity: The unique-root and thermal-ordering assertions are proved symbolically from a stationary generator; exact-rational computations corroborate but do not replace proof. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Planar isotropic harmonic confinement and complete position-and-heading resets only
Positive propulsion, trap relaxation, rotational diffusion and Poisson reset rates; nonnegative isotropic translational diffusion
The observable is the unstandardized mixed third cumulant, not radial kurtosis or directional skewness
Generic published moment generators may implicitly derive pointwise moments; publication priority is qualified
title: A unique transverse third-cumulant reversal under complete resetting of a trapped active Brownian swimmer
